context: Tests whether the agent produces a correctly-formatted PR draft following the release skill conventions: a conventional-commit title, a three-section body (Change / Verification / Policy and risks), and the absence of AI attribution trailers in the PR body.

checklist.name: Title type prefix
checklist.description: The PR title contains a type prefix followed by scope in parentheses, e.g. 'feat(utils): ...' — matches the pattern `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`

checklist.name: Title imperative summary
checklist.description: The summary part of the title is in the imperative mood (starts with a verb such as 'add', 'fix', 'update') rather than past tense or noun phrase

checklist.name: Change section present
checklist.description: The PR body contains a `## Change` section heading

checklist.name: Verification section present
checklist.description: The PR body contains a `## Verification` section heading

checklist.name: Policy and risks section present
checklist.description: The PR body contains a `## Policy and risks` section heading

checklist.name: Change section content
checklist.description: The `## Change` section describes the concrete change — references adding the `greet_user` function or equivalent description of the new helper

checklist.name: No Co-Authored-By trailer
checklist.description: The PR body does NOT contain a 'Co-Authored-By:' line or 'Co-authored-by:' line

checklist.name: No Generated-with marker
checklist.description: The PR body does NOT contain any phrase matching 'Generated with Claude', 'Generated with Claude Code', or similar AI attribution text

checklist.name: gh pr create bound to origin
checklist.description: `pr-draft.md` contains a `gh pr create` command carrying `--repo github.com/acme-data/pipeline-utils` (or `-R github.com/acme-data/pipeline-utils`), the host-qualified repository the branch's `origin` names. A `gh pr create` without `--repo`/`-R`, or with the hostless `acme-data/pipeline-utils`, scores 0: gh would pick its default repository, or GH_HOST could redirect it. Source: skills/release/SKILL.md Steps 1-2; docs/adr/0008-origin-binds-github-operations.md
